title: The northern lights can reach much further south than you might think
alt: A bright green ribbon of light curls across a dark night sky above snowy ground and a bare tree.

posts.facebook:
The aurora is charged particles from the Sun lighting up the upper atmosphere. When activity is strong it can be seen from as much as 1,000 kilometres away, from a hilltop with a clear view north. The skill is watching the alerts and being ready to go: our page has the alert services for the UK and the US, and how to pick your spot.

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/see-the-northern-lights/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do

Photo: Svein-Magne Tunli - tunliweb.no, CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0), via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Northern_Lights_-_Aurora_Borealis_Ringvass%C3%B8ya_Troms%C3%B8_Norway.jpg (cropped).
